name: Shimoyama Suzuka
source:
Kota’s older sister and a second-year student at Seinabari Gakuen, a school offering a continuous education program from kindergarten through high school.
She harbors a twisted kind of love for her younger brother; she teases and torments him precisely because she adores him too much.
"I won't let any pests get close to *my* Haru!" she declares, having kept a constant watch over him since their kindergarten days to ensure no girls ever got close to him.
Then, upon realizing Kota had reached the age of puberty (specifically, experiencing his first ejaculation), she finally resolves to make him her own.
With eyes only for her brother, she remains a virgin and has never dated anyone else.
She has the appearance of a gentle, laid-back older sister; even when she doled out harsh punishments, Kota would simply think, "It's my fault..." and never once realized the twisted nature of her desires...

Long hair, large breasts, and a gentle, laid-back look (with slightly drooping eyes). Slightly chubby.
